en.summary: Food poisoning usually causes vomiting and/or diarrhoea. NHS: rest, fluids in small sips; most improve in a few days. Urgent care for dehydration signs, blood in stool, high fever, severe pain, or vulnerability (infants, elderly, pregnant, immunocompromised). Antibiotics usually not needed — never invent them.
seeDoctorIf: Symptoms lasting more than a few days
selfCare: Small frequent sips of fluid; rest; hand hygiene; avoid preparing food for others while ill
doNot: Do not give anti-diarrhoeals to children without advice

fr.summary: L'intoxication alimentaire provoque vomissements/diarrhée. Repos, hydratation. Avis si déshydratation, sang, fièvre, terrain fragile. Pas d'antibiotiques inventés.
selfCare: Petites gorgées ; repos ; hygiène des mains

he.summary: הרעלת מזון: הקאות ו/או שלשול. מנוחה, לגימות. ייעוץ בהתייבשות, דם, חום, או אוכלוסיות בסיכון. אין אנטיביוטיקה מומצאת.

ru.summary: Пищевое отравление: рвота и/или понос. Покой, глотки жидкости. Врач при обезвоживании, крови, лихорадке, группах риска. Антибиотики не выдумывать.
